about: Launch and landing times of past Moon landings, UTC, each from the official page in source_url (read 2026-11-15). travel_hours is computed by the API from these two times. A landing of null means we have not found an official landing time to the minute (to confirm).

missions.name: Apollo 11
missions.note: NSSDCA: launch on 16 July 1969 at 13:32 UT; the LM landed at 20:17:40 UT on 20 July.

missions.name: Apollo 12
missions.note: NSSDCA 1969-099A: launch on 14 November 1969 at 16:22:00 UT; the LM separated at 04:16:03 UT on 19 November. NSSDCA 1969-099C (https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/nmc/spacecraft/display.action?id=1969-099C): landed at 06:54:35 UT.

missions.name: Apollo 14
missions.note: NSSDCA: launched on 31 January 1971 at 21:03:02 UT; the LM separated at 04:50:44 UT on 5 February and landed at 09:18:11 UT.

missions.name: Apollo 15
missions.note: NSSDCA: launched on 26 July 1971 at 13:34:00 UT; landed at 22:16:29 UT on 30 July 1971.

missions.name: Apollo 16
missions.note: NSSDCA: launched on 16 April 1972 at 17:54:00; the LM landed at 02:23:35 UT on 21 April.

missions.name: Apollo 17
missions.note: NSSDCA: lifted off at 05:33:00 UT on 7 December 1972; the LM separated at 17:20:56 UT on 11 December 1972 and landed at 19:54:57 UT.

missions.name: Chandrayaan-3
missions.note: ISRO: launch scheduled for 14 July 2023 at 14:35 Hrs IST (09:05 UTC), and on 14 July 'LVM3 M4 vehicle successfully launched Chandrayaan-3 into orbit'. Soft landing on 23 August 2023; the page gives powered descent 'around 1745 Hrs IST' but no landing time, so landing is null (to confirm).

missions.name: SLIM
missions.note: JAXA press release of 20 January 2024: landed on 20 January 2024 at 0:20 am JST (15:20 UTC on 19 January). Launch from the JAXA SLIM project page (https://global.jaxa.jp/projects/sas/slim/): 8:42:11 a.m. JST on 7 September 2023, 23:42:11 UTC on 6 September. SLIM took a long, low-energy route, so its travel time is not comparable with Apollo's.
